title: U.S. St. Lawrence Seaway commercial availability reaches 99.4 percent
summary: DOT reports 99.4 percent commercial availability for the U.S. portion of the St. Lawrence Seaway in FY 2025, above the 99.0 percent target. Denominator: Commercially scheduled operating time for the U.S. Seaway system under DOT's availability method; the FY 2021 through FY 2025 series is 99.6, 99.6, 98.7, 99.0, and 99.4 percent.
